evals.name: project-setup
evals.prompt: I want to start a new Obsidian plugin that adds a button to the ribbon to insert a timestamp. How should I set up the project structure and testing?
evals.expected_output: The agent should propose a structure with src/ and tests/, recommend Vitest, and mention the obsidian mock setup.

evals.name: testing-logic
evals.prompt: I have a function that formats dates for my Obsidian plugin. How do I write a test for it using Vitest and mock the Obsidian API?
evals.expected_output: The agent should show a Vitest test file and explain how to alias 'obsidian' to a mock file.

evals.name: github-actions-release
evals.prompt: How do I configure GitHub Actions to automatically release my Obsidian plugin when I push a new tag?
evals.expected_output: The agent should provide a .github/workflows/release.yml example that uploads main.js, manifest.json, and styles.css.
